name: Adriaen van Ostade

summary.text: Adriaen van Ostade was a Dutch Golden Age painter of genre works, showing the everyday life of ordinary men and women.

3224276: The Fish Market is an oil on canvas painting by Adriaen van Ostade, from 1659. It is held in the Louvre, in Paris.
5719359: Barber Extracting a Tooth is an oil-on-panel genre painting by Adriaen van Ostade, dated from c. 1630–1635. It is held in the Kunsthistorisches Museum, in Vienna.
120497813: Customers Conversing in a Tavern is a Dutch Golden Age Oil-on-panel painting by artist Adriaen van Ostade completed in 1671.
